description: Returns the account's plan, limits (participants per session, sessions per month, presentations, concurrent live sessions), usage this period, a `summary` sentence with the same numbers, and `pricing_url`, the public page listing the plans. A session counts toward sessions per month only once `counted_session_min_participants` (3) or more participants join, so rehearsals with fewer are free, and resuming a live session never counts again. Use it to check limits before writing a deck, or when a quota or participant-limit error occurs. Billing is managed on the Sparka account page, not through this tool. Share links with the user; never open them yourself.
name: sparka_account_get

counted_session_min_participants.description: A session counts toward sessions_per_month only once this many participants have joined it.

summary.description: The plan's limits, usage and counting rule in one plain paragraph.

title: Get account and plan
